column1: # BAL-169 (15 Oct 2026, account 1): further glossed runs of the same office hand on Baluze 169 c174-c188 (the f.80 Memoire's continuation,
# July 1639), read by this worker's eye at 2400 px with zooms of each target numeral (not blind: I knew key.tsv). Same conventions as
# glossed_pairs.tsv (' = separate rising acute; : = second dot; plain = no mark). Only tokens I could place under the gloss; a 16 whose mark
# I could not settle is left out (c181 'de la Couronne', c185 L1/L3, c187 'les grandes de', c178 'deffiance').
